text: The bidder must be an active taxpayer listed on the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) Active Taxpayers List (ATL) for Income Tax and Sales Tax on the date of bid submission.
The bidder must possess a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and Sales Tax Registration Number (STRN).
The bidder must have at least five (05) years of verifiable corporate operational experience in Pakistan in enterprise software development or identity access management.
The bidder must submit an original affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper stating that the firm is not blacklisted or debarred by any government department, PPRA, or international agency.
The bidder must demonstrate an average annual financial turnover of at least PKR 150 Million over the last three (03) audited financial fiscal years.
The bidder must submit the original Bid Securing Declaration as per Form TECH-4 in the technical proposal envelope.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The solution shall support OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth 2.0, and SAML 2.0 federation protocols out of the box.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The system must support citizen authentication via Pakistani National ID (CNIC) and integration with NADRA Pak-Identity verification APIs.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: All citizen profile data and audit records must reside exclusively within servers located physically inside Pakistan (local data residency requirement).

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The vendor shall provide high-availability architecture guaranteeing a minimum system uptime SLA of 99.9% on a 24x7x365 basis.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The system will support automated failover to the secondary disaster recovery site with an RPO under 5 minutes and RTO under 15 minutes.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The vendor must supply comprehensive RESTful APIs with OpenAPI 3.0 specification for third-party agency integration.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The platform should preferably support passwordless authentication mechanisms including WebAuthn and FIDO2 standards.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The vendor will provide three (03) years of comprehensive on-site warranty and software maintenance support starting from the Date of Operational Acceptance.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: The vendor shall provide certified technical training for twelve (12) IT staff members of the procuring agency prior to system go-live.

section: SECTION 3: SCOPE OF SERVICES & TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
text: Bidders should submit an illustrated project deployment organogram and risk mitigation matrix.
Bids will be evaluated using Quality and Cost Based Selection (QCBS) mechanism with 70% weight for Technical Proposal and 30% weight for Financial Proposal.
The minimum qualifying technical score is 70 marks out of 100.
Firm Corporate Profile & Experience: 5 projects = 25 marks; 3-4 projects = 18 marks; 1-2 projects = 10 marks; 0 projects = 0 marks.
Technical Architecture & Methodology: Architectural soundness (15 marks), Security controls & OWASP compliance (10 marks), Work plan (5 marks).
Key Human Resources: Lead Solution Architect (10 marks), Security Specialist (8 marks), DevOps/Cloud Engineer (7 marks).
Live System Demonstration: Live demonstration of OIDC flow (10 marks), Admin portal & audit logging (10 marks).
